allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:4173/api/runtime/halls" -Method Get -ErrorAction Stop; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } catch { Write-Output "Server not reachable: $_" })
